proof_summary: The sum satisfies the recurrence \(a_{n+1}=(2^n-1)a_n+2^{\binom{n+1}{2}}\). For odd primes, Fermat’s theorem makes both recurrence terms invariant under a shift of \(2(p-1)\), with the boundary value resetting to \(a_1=1\), so induction propagates the congruence; for \(p=2\), every term is shown to be odd.
